Item 1A. Risk Factors

Our dependence on a single supplier could interrupt manufacturing and adversely affect our operating results.

We maintain long term supply agreements and alternative production arrangements to support manufacturing activity in multiple regions and at several facilities. These arrangements require regular review and may need to be changed when economic conditions or customer demand change materially.

Item 2. Properties

Our offices occupy several buildings.
